title: Isandro and the Crown
author: Jonah Dravenmoor
blurb: Hazel Montrose, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
